name: Rite Stone
description: Press a rite stone to the palm and let it feed the arms a clean charge of qi.

name: Keystone Screen
description: Set a keystone before the body and raise a ward from it that rings when struck.

name: Binding Pin
description: Drive a pin of qi through the shadow of a foe and hold the foe still by it.

name: Pulse Glyph
description: Etch a glyph that pulses once for each body that enters the reach of the array.

name: Pillar Burst
description: Drive a pillar of stored qi upward from a keystone so it bursts in a wide flat ring.

name: Rite Hold
description: Hold a rite sign over a foe's chest and seal the qi inside until the sign is lifted.

name: Anchor Leap
description: Spring from one set anchor to its twin so the stored qi carries the body across the gap.

name: Keystone Pair
description: Lay two keystones apart and join them with an array that shocks any foe who crosses the line.

name: Rite Matrix
description: Hold a matrix over a patch of ground that presses down on every foe's qi while the rite stands.

name: Keystone Draw
description: Draw the force of a heavy blow into the keystone and hold it there until the maker is ready to loose it.

name: Far Stone
description: Set a stone high up and read through it every mover on the ground below.

name: Eye Plate
description: Hold up a round plate of qi with an eye marked on it to take the blow where it lands.

name: Reach Cord
description: Cast a long cord of qi from a high mark to loop a foe at the edge of reach.

name: Sight Spark
description: Loose a spark from the eye-mark straight along the line of sight so it strikes where the maker looks.

name: Roost Step
description: Step onto a perch of qi in the air for one pace and drop onto the next mark.

name: Hawk Net
description: Drop a net of marked cords from above so that it falls over every foe in the patch.

name: Wide Glyph
description: Open a broad glyph that shows every flow of qi in the area and which are closing.

name: Clear Pin
description: Drive a pin into the centre of a foe's glowing mark and tear the whole mark loose.

name: Eye Array
description: Raise an array of eye-marks that sees all within it and shocks the first foe to step inside.

name: Falling Marks
description: Drop a rain of charged marks from the high array onto every foe the array has found.

name: Hawk Matrix
description: Hold a high matrix that reads the heading and strength of every foe and marks them for the maker.

name: Track Stone
description: Charge a stone on the near track so the same charge sits waiting on the far track.

name: Dual Plate
description: Raise a plate on each track and let a blow strike whichever the foe has not guessed.

name: Parallel Cord
description: Run two cords side by side across a foe so that if one slips the other holds.

name: Cross Flare
description: Flare both tracks together so the two waves cross at the foe's centre.

name: Track Seal
description: Seal one of a foe's two paths of movement so only the other remains open.

name: Split Glyph
description: Split a glyph into two halves and read from the difference what lies between them.

name: Dual Array
description: Raise an array on each track so the foe cannot leave one without entering the other.

name: Parallel Ward
description: Hold two wards in line so that a blow turned off the first is turned again by the second.

name: Track Phase
description: Step through a pair of linked marks as if they were one door and leave the foe's line.

name: Heart Stone
description: Warm a stone against the chest until it beats with the maker's pulse and feeds back steady qi.

name: Soft Plate
description: Lift a yielding plate of qi that gives with a blow and returns to shape afterward.

name: Close Cord
description: Tie a close cord about a foe's waist and draw it toward the maker.

name: Pulse Reader
description: Lay a mark over a body and read the pulse and the weak points in its flow of qi.

name: Paired Hop
description: Hop between the two halves of a paired mark and land balanced on the far half.

name: Heart Flare
description: Flare the heart stones together to send a short hard pulse out from the maker.

name: Even Hold
description: Even out the qi in a raging foe by holding a steady array over the foe's chest.

name: Ward Weave
description: Weave a ward that stops a blow and then guides the spent force away from the body.

name: Sealed Pulse
description: Press a seal over a foe's wrist so that the qi stops flowing to the striking hand.

name: Heart Array
description: Lay an array of paired stones about the maker that wards a ring of ground and shocks foes inside.

name: Clearing Ring
description: Hold a ring over an ally that draws poison and taint and the sting of a curse out of the body.

name: Mending Array
description: Lay an array of paired stones that closes the wounds of every ally standing within it.

name: Heading Stone
description: Set a stone to the wind and read from its hum the heading of whoever approaches.

name: Wind Ward
description: Raise a ward on the wind side of the body so that the force of a blow thins out.

name: Drift Cord
description: Let a cord of qi drift on the wind until it snags a foe's leg and pulls tight.

name: Oath Pin
description: Fix an oath pin at the breast and draw a steady charge from the vow it holds.

name: Sworn Flare
description: Flare a sworn mark so its qi flies outward in a wide hard gust.

name: Heading Vise
description: Hold a foe to a single heading so its qi cannot turn or spread.

name: Slant Step
description: Lean into the wind and let a laid mark push the body three paces along the heading.

name: Heading Array
description: Lay an array of open stones that turns every foe to the same heading and spoils their aim.

name: Oathbound Matrix
description: Hold a matrix bound to the maker's oath that binds only those who have sworn against it.

name: Bearing Flash
description: Take the heading in a single flash along laid marks and appear at the end of the line.

name: Gust Stone
description: Set a stone in the wind and let the gust that strikes it feed the maker's next blow.

name: Lee Plate
description: Hold a plate of qi on the sheltered side of the body and take the blow on it.

name: Whip Cord
description: Whip a cord of qi on the wind around a foe's arm and cinch it tight.

name: Vane Glyph
description: Etch a vane glyph that turns toward every shift in the flow of qi about it.

name: Skim Step
description: Skim across the ground on a rising current held up by a line of marks.

name: Gust Burst
description: Burst a set of gust marks together to send a heavy wave across the ground.

name: Lull Seal
description: Seal a calm into the air about a foe so that every wind-borne technique dies there.

name: Turn Glyph
description: Turn a foe's glyph half about with a flick so that it works against its maker.

name: Gust Array
description: Lay an array that gathers the wind into itself and throws it at the first foe to cross.

name: Updraft Matrix
description: Hold a matrix that lifts a foe's feet on a hard updraft and takes away its footing.

name: Gale Draw
description: Draw the force of an attack into the array as a sail takes the wind and hold it.

name: Open Stone
description: Leave a stone unmarked so that qi passes through it freely and shows its path.

name: Loose Ward
description: Hold a ward slack so that a blow slides along it and does not catch.

name: Free Cord
description: Leave one end of a cord of qi unfixed and let it coil on its own about the foe.

name: Open Burst
description: Break an open mark so that its qi spreads out as a long low wave.

name: Spread Hold
description: Spread a thin layer of held qi across the ground so that every foe on it is slowed.

name: Roam Step
description: Roam from mark to mark across the open array with no stride that is fixed to a path.

name: Unwalled Array
description: Lay a wide array with no closed edge so that foes cannot find where it begins.

name: Open Matrix
description: Hold an open matrix that turns each blow along its lines and shuts on nothing.

name: Open Flash
description: Flash from the near edge of the array to the far edge along the open marks.

name: Heading Press
description: Press qi along a chosen heading so the next blows of the maker follow it truly.

name: Sworn Plate
description: Hold a plate sworn to hold and let it carry a blow without cracking.

name: Drag Cord
description: Loop a cord on a foe's belt and drag the foe a pace along the heading.

name: Oath Reader
description: Read an oath mark and learn from its glow whether the one who swore it still holds to it.

name: Step Mark
description: Lay a mark ahead and step onto it with the charge of the mark in the heel.

name: Heading Burst
description: Burst a line of marks along the heading so the wave runs the full length at once.

name: Seal Hold
description: Hold a seal on a foe who has sworn against the maker and shut the foe's qi inside.

name: Squared Ward
description: Hold a ward true to its heading so that a blow strikes its edge and slides on.

name: Float Hold
description: Let a held mark drift over the foe and press on the qi it passes across.

name: Sworn Array
description: Lay an array sworn to a heading that shocks every foe who turns from it.

name: Heading Lattice
description: Hold a lattice along the heading that shields those who stand behind it and holds the foe off.

name: Fresh Wind
description: Draw a clean wind through the array and carry poison and taint out of the allies within it.

name: Mending Wind
description: Let a mending wind run through the array so that it closes wounds and clears the blood of allies.
